newsitem.title: USA: Keycorp unit completes loan securitization.
newsitem.headline: Keycorp unit completes loan securitization.

text.p: KeyBank USA, a wholly owned subsidiary of KeyCorp, said on Friday it issued $797.8 million of asset-backed notes and certificates through KeyCorp Student Loan Trust 1996-A.
The transaction marks Key's sixth public securitization of student loans, the company said.
"The deal was widely distributed in the market and a great success," said Craig Platt, portfolio manager at KeyBank USA in a prepared statement.
KeyCorp is one of the nation's foremost providers of financial services for education needs and a leader in alternative student loan products.
